title: Incremental predictive value of CMR phenotyping for major adverse cardiovascular events: an interpretable machine learning study from UK Biobank
summary: Unsupervised clustering and XGBoost with SHAP show CMR-derived phenotypes improve MACE prediction over conventional risk factors in UK Biobank, with an independent cross-modality cohort check.
ai_technology: Unsupervised clustering defines CMR phenotypes; XGBoost and SHAP assess their contribution to MACE-risk prediction.
